name: Mai☆MAI Funifuni Papyuun to Iwasecharu!
original_name: 舞☆MAI ふにふにぱぴゅーんといわせちゃる！
source:
Mai is a little girl with cat ears who studies the art of magic. Unfortunately, she doesn't always do her homework, and sometimes loses control of her magical powers. This is precisely what happened one day, when she accidentally unleashed a magical spell upon terrified classmates. Now the poor girl is being hunted down by male and female students, teachers, and other people, and she has to fight for her life while perfecting her magic-casting skills.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/mai]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
麻衣是一名长着猫耳、学习魔法的小女孩。可惜她并不总是完成作业，有时还会失去对魔力的控制。某天，她意外向惊恐的同学施放了魔法，正是那一天，一切失控了。如今，这个可怜的女孩遭到男女学生、教师及其他人的追捕，只能一边磨炼施法技巧，一边为性命而战。
